summary: Iteration 8 tested 3 new features — (A) Recap itinerary bonus slides in slideshow + downloadable export, (B) 'Log expense' from itinerary items prefilling the add-expense dialog with title+category=activities, (C) Trip countdown badges on /trips cards. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_features.py — 6/6 pytest cases PASS in 9.25s. Covers: GET /api/recap/{token} includes 'itinerary' array sorted by (date,time) with keys {date,time,title,place}; empty itinerary → empty array; /api/recap/{token}/share HTML page with og:image/og:title AND /api/recap/{token}/og.png (image content-type, >500 bytes) both still work; itinerary POST/GET/PUT/DELETE CRUD regression; chat reaction POST regression; expense POST with category=activities creates+lists+shows in /balances total_spent. Frontend Playwright (aarav@test.com login → /dashboard): /trips cards countdown states — TEST_Iter8_Ongoing (2026-07-29→2026-08-02, today=2026-07-30) shows 'On trip now' with emerald-600 bg ✓; TEST_Iter8_Past_XXXX (2026-07-10→07-15, fully past) shows NO trip-countdown-badge ✓; TEST_Iter8Empty/TEST_Iter8/Feature Test Trip (future) show 'N days to go' teal badges ✓; toggle-archived-btn expands archived-trips-section, TEST_Iter8_Archived (past + archived) shows NO badge ✓. Fixture trip TEST_Iter8 (6a6b66149a70d11e6e66f0fe) → Itinerary tab: 3 items each with itinerary-expense-btn ✓; clicking first btn opens add-expense-dialog with expense-description-input='Fort Kochi walk' and category combobox='activities' ✓; filling amount=137 and submitting closes dialog, Expenses tab lists the new expense with '137' visible, Balances tab shows 'Meera owes Aarav Sharma ₹69' (correct 50/50 split of 137) ✓. Recap /recap/Cv146FycxVg: slideshow order via next-btn navigation = title → itinerary(Day 1: 09:00 Fort Kochi walk / 13:00 Seafood lunch) → itinerary(Day 4: — Backwater houseboat) → stats → wraps back to title ✓; recap-slide-itinerary has 'THE PLAN' heading, 'Day N', localized date, and time/title/place rows ✓; slide dots increased in count matching added slides ✓. recap-download-btn → recap-download-images-btn produced travelo-recap-test-iter8.zip (177,731 bytes) containing 4 PNGs (travelo-recap-01..04.png = title + 2 itinerary days + stats since trip has 0 memories) — no console errors from the export path ✓. WhatsApp button still visible in footer (green circle). Only console errors observed are pre-existing 401s from /api/auth/me on the public recap page (no auth cookie in that context) — benign. Seed trips (3 short-lived TEST_Iter8_Ongoing/Past/Archived) cleaned up; fixture trip TEST_Iter8 left intact per instructions but now carries 1 residual expense (Fort Kochi walk ₹137, activities) created during UI test — main agent may want to delete it.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/recapExport.js buildItinerarySlides groups by date but caps slice(0, 6) items per day — days with >6 planned items silently drop the extras from both the on-screen and downloaded slides. Consider paginating (split into multiple 'Day N (cont.)' slides) or at least surfacing a '+N more' footer row instead of a silent truncation.

frontend/src/lib/recapExport.js the day number Math.round((date - start)/86400000) + 1 assumes start_date is in the same timezone offset; near DST boundaries or if trip.start_date crosses months this can be off by 1 (currently OK for TEST_Iter8 which produced 'Day 1' and 'Day 4' correctly, but worth a Math.floor + safeguard).

frontend/src/pages/TripsPage.jsx tripCountdown uses new Date('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00') interpreted as LOCAL time and compares to a now zeroed at LOCAL midnight. That is correct, but a user viewing the page from a timezone west of the trip start-date's timezone can see 'On trip now' up to 24h before the intended trip start. Consider treating start_date/end_date as trip-local and marking start-of-day/end-of-day accordingly.

backend/routers_memories.py get_recap sort([('date',1),('time',1)]) works for HH:MM strings but items missing 'time' will sort as '' (before any real time). Currently the recap slide renders '—' for missing time — fine — but if a day contains a mix of dated-only and timed items, the dated-only rows appear first regardless of intent. Consider sort([('date',1),('time',1),('_id',1)]) and pushing empty-time items to end of day.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (countdown ongoing/past/archived states, itinerary-expense-btn on every item, dialog prefill title+activities, expense creation → Expenses+Balances update, recap slideshow contains itinerary slides between title and stats, image-export zip contains itinerary slides, WhatsApp button intact)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 short-lived TEST_Iter8_ trips (Ongoing/Past/Archived) via /api/trips (+ /archive) to exercise the 3 countdown states; all deleted via DELETE /api/trips/{id} in teardown. Backend pytest created ~5 more TEST_Iter8_* trips, all cleaned in module teardown. UI test on fixture TEST_Iter8 (6a6b66149a70d11e6e66f0fe) added one expense 'Fort Kochi walk' ₹137 category=activities as part of the expense-from-plan verification — this is residue on the fixture trip; main agent may remove it before final delivery.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iter8 features PASS end-to-end. To reproduce countdown testing you must seed trips with dates relative to today's server date (2026-07-30 at time of testing) — use /api/trips POST then optionally /api/trips/{id}/archive. Recap public page shows 401s on /api/auth/me in console — these are expected because the recap route is public; do NOT treat as regressions. Fixture recap token Cv146FycxVg is bound to TEST_Iter8; if that trip is deleted the token 404s. recap-download-images-btn triggers a browser download event — use page.expect_download to capture it; the zip filename is 'travelo-recap-{slug}.zip'. Slide navigation uses [data-testid=recap-next-btn]; ArrowRight also works. buildItinerarySlides slices each day to 6 items.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects. Code-review comments captured as forward-looking hardening (silent truncation past 6 items/day, timezone assumptions in day-number and countdown, sort stability when time is empty).
